reference.mode: development-only differential reference; no runtime or CI dependency

cases.acceptedDifference: Poppler reports the raw subset name; Poppler.Net exposes DejaVuSans and retains ABCDEF+DejaVuSans separately.
Only safe URI and local GoTo overlays are emitted; active actions are inspection-only and cross-page destinations are removed from isolated pages.
Form values and appearances are read-only; extracted widgets become terminal fields and XFA or JavaScript calculation is not executed.
Managed HTML has no viewer chrome and complex SVG regions use deterministic bounded PNG fallbacks instead of Poppler's HTML framing.
Reusable JPEG, JP2 and self-contained JBIG2 payloads remain original; masks, PDF-only color semantics and dependent filters are composited into PNG.
Conversion requires a successful unlock and page extraction intentionally emits an unencrypted standalone PDF.
Poppler.Net fails before unbounded allocation when configured limits are exceeded; recovery remains conservative and diagnostic-driven.

acceptedProductBehaviors: Structured JSON, XML and XHTML use Poppler.Net schema 1.0 and stable identifiers; Poppler has no equivalent versioned manifest contract.
Managed HTML contains only requested pages at the top-left origin and never adds Poppler viewer frames, navigation or centered document decoration.
Executable PDF actions, XFA, JavaScript and media activation are never copied into HTML or executed.
Original image streams are exported only when independently reusable; decoded PNG is the deterministic compatibility fallback.
The runtime remains managed-only; Poppler executables are optional development references.
